description: Source code for handling client timeouts and blocked client management in Redis, including timeout checks, radix tree management for blocked clients, and timeout parsing.

methods.name: checkBlockedClientTimeout
methods.description: Checks if a blocked client has timed out, replies and unblocks if so.

methods.name: clientsCronHandleTimeout
methods.description: Handles client timeouts periodically, closing idle clients and managing blocked clients.

methods.name: encodeTimeoutKey
methods.description: Encodes a client timeout and ID into a 16-byte radix tree key.

methods.name: decodeTimeoutKey
methods.description: Decodes a radix tree key into timeout and client pointer.

methods.name: addClientToTimeoutTable
methods.description: Adds a client with a blocking timeout to the radix tree for timeout management.

methods.name: removeClientFromTimeoutTable
methods.description: Removes a client from the timeout radix tree.

methods.name: handleBlockedClientsTimeout
methods.description: Unblocks clients whose blocking timeout has expired.

methods.name: getTimeoutFromObjectOrReply
methods.description: Parses a timeout value from an object, converting to milliseconds.
